description.description: An infographic titled 'Trees per person :' depicting an illustration of a tree where different branches represent various countries. The size of the leaves on each branch corresponds to the number of trees per person in that country. Canada has the largest leaf, while India has the smallest. The bottom of the image includes a global average.
